verification_policy: Single-skill Strike Super research: independently verify Xenoverse 2 identity, acquisition route, cost, CaC availability, and mechanics; preserve unsupported stamina and Ultimate Finish fields as null.
research_scope: Power Pole — Strike Super / Skill Shop acquisition research.

verification_audit.method: Reconciled the existing research record against the current Xenoverse 2-specific Power Pole page, the Future Warrior technique list, and independent GT Pack 1 content documentation. Xenoverse 2 evidence was used for classification, Ki cost, Skill Shop route, and mechanics; older Xenoverse evidence was used only to establish the DLC provenance.

duplicate_check.identity_note: No existing repository research batch for Power Pole was found. The canonical identity is Super / Strike and is kept distinct from Power Pole Combo and Power Pole Pro.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 documentation identifies Power Pole as a Strike Super Attack, distinct from Power Pole Combo and Power Pole Pro.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 documentation lists Skill Shop acquisition. Independent franchise documentation identifies the Power Pole skill as GT Pack 1 content; therefore the research record now records GT Pack 1 as the DLC requirement while retaining Skill Shop as the acquisition route.
verification_audit.finish_policy: ultimate_finish_required remains null because the documented acquisition route is the Skill Shop rather than a Parallel Quest reward.
verification_audit.cost_policy: 100 Ki is directly documented; no reliable canonical stamina value was established. No Skill Shop Zeni price is promoted because the accessible 300,000-zeni listing belongs to the original Xenoverse Skill Shop rather than Xenoverse 2.
verification_audit.mechanics_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 documentation explicitly records long-range straight-line weapon behavior, single-hit Strike classification, and increased damage against grounded/pinned opponents.

records.name: Power Pole
records.skill_description: Extend the Power Pole over a long distance to jab the opponent with a straight-line Strike attack.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2-specific skill documentation confirms a long-range, single-hit weapon-based Strike Super that travels in a straight line and gains increased damage when the opponent is pinned against the ground. The documented Ki cost is 100. Exact frame, hitbox, and universal damage values are not promoted as canonical numeric fields.
records.acquisition_notes: Current Xenoverse 2 documentation lists the Skill Shop as the Future Warrior acquisition route. Independent Xenoverse documentation identifies Power Pole as GT Pack 1 content and Xenoverse 2 documentation identifies it as a returning GT Goku/GT Pack skill. Power Pole Combo is a separate skill and remains distinct.
records.pve_notes: Skill Shop acquisition; GT Pack 1 content; no Parallel Quest or Ultimate Finish requirement established for the Xenoverse 2 Skill Shop route.
records.pvp_notes: Long-range straight-line Strike Super with weapon reach and documented ground-pin synergy; detailed frame and matchup behavior remains version-sensitive.
